Floor held at 101; quantified the loop.c gate that costs the 7th callee-saved register (threshold bracketed 26..29, insn 312 savings 1 lifetime 2) and PROVED that killing that hoist alone restores tar

Floor 101 -> 99 and build_insns 193 -> 194 (= target's 194): declaring D_800A3590 as an array of a 2-byte record routes the read through expand_expr's COMPONENT_REF/get_inner_reference offset path, wh

Floor 99 -> 56: giving var_s0 three source increment sites raises loop.c's bl->biv_count to 3, zeroing the D_800A3590 address giv's benefit so strength_reduce REJECTS the reduction that s3 pinned as t

Floor 56 -> 53 and every FAKE construct retired: spelling the second loop as a top-test for() whose secondary counters are expressions of the loop variable makes jump.c's duplicate_loop_exit_test fire

frontier.hypothesis: The 0x18 frame overshoot is three dead pseudos left behind by duplicate_loop_exit_test's reg_map copies; a source shape whose exit test has fewer replaceable intermediate registers should not leave them.
frontier.mechanism: jump.c:2229-2257 gives a NEW pseudo to every insn in the exit test that sets a register whose first and last uid both lie inside the exit code and which is not a user variable. Each such original pseudo, once cse_around_loop has consumed it, survives only as a (use (reg)) insn, wins no hard register in .greg, and is given an 8-byte stack slot. Fewer intermediate temporaries in the bound expression, or naming the bound in a user variable, means fewer leftovers.
frontier.next_probe: Read tmp/grind/func_80070C70/dumps/text1b.lreg for insns 551-556 and identify which bound sub-expression each of pseudos 118, 168 and 171 came from, then sweep bound spellings that name the bound in a USER VARIABLE (jump.c's replacement skips user variables) or that reduce the number of intermediates -- e.g. hoisting D_800A35B0 or the whole bound into a local declared at function scope and read in the for-condition.

frontier.hypothesis: The target reduces D_800A3560's giv to a byte OFFSET (lui $at,%hi / addu $at,$at,$s2 / lbu %lo($at), addiu $s2,$s2,3) where we reduce it to a full ADDRESS (lui $s2 / addiu $s2 / lbu 0($s2)); a different index spelling or array declaration should reproduce the offset form.
frontier.mechanism: loop.c's strength_reduce folds the %hi/%lo symbol base into the giv when the address is a legitimate giv of the biv. Whether the symbol is absorbed depends on how the address expression is built in expand_expr, which the array's declared element type and the index expression control.
frontier.next_probe: Sweep D_800A3560 index and declaration spellings on the floor-53 chassis: u8[] with `[var_s0 * 3]`, a 3-byte record array, `[i]` over a stride-3 struct, and a separate index variable; read the `Loop from` section of tmp/grind/func_80070C70/dumps/text1b.loop for which giv is reduced in each.

frontier.hypothesis: IconC70's `s16 sp50[12]` tail is a placeholder; its real field list is recoverable from func_80069898's other callers and is the only declaration still blocking submission.
frontier.mechanism: Carried unspent from s1/s2/s3/s4. The 0x20 size is proven by the target's frame arithmetic, but the trailing array is a spelling of that fact, not evidence for it. The RecC70 half of this item is now CLOSED (s5: D_800A3590 is a plain s16[]).
frontier.next_probe: Read the $a1-relative stores in func_8006B120, func_8006CFBC, func_800720FC, func_80074488 and func_8006F97C to recover the real member layout at offsets 0x50-0x67.
